display_long_description:
In the script of the scenario «Fire in the Engine Room_VR-ME» after some welding work in the engine room, a fire starts in the bilge of the engine room, also spreading to the main electrical panel.The «Fire in the Engine Room_VR-ME» app includes actions mentioned below that are urgent at the situation of fire:

-Go to the meeting point. Recount

-Grab, carry and put on ﬁre ﬁghter equipment, prove function     and adjustment

-Grab one ﬁre extinguisher and put it ready for use.

-Going to the engine control room and trying to suﬀocate the ﬁre, with a ﬁre  extinguisher.                          

The development of the «Fire in the Engine Room_VR-ME» app is co-funded by the Erasmus+ Programme of the European Union under the framework of the Virtual Reality for Maritime Emergencies (VR-ME) project.
